title: Integral constant sections generate closed direct images
statement: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be any closed immersion of schemes. On the small pro-etale sites, let $\mathbf Z_Z$ and $\mathbf Z_X$ denote the constant sheaves of abelian groups with value $\mathbf Z$. The canonical map $\mathbf Z_X\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], induced by the same constant integer on every pulled-back chart, is an epimorphism. This applies in particular to the projective-line diagonal used in finite supported normalization. No nonemptiness, noetherian, or coefficient-prime assumption is required.

source.place: Section 9, proof of Theorem 9.4, p. 67, exact sequence (*) for the constant integer sheaf; pro-etale realization by Bhatt--Scholze Lemma 4.2.12.

proof.text: Use the proved constantSheafToContinuousSheaf isomorphism of WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.FiniteCoefficientCohomology with discrete coefficient group Z. The sheaf on a chart V is the abelian group of continuous maps from its underlying space to discrete Z, with the specified universe lift. Restriction to the base-changed closed subscheme is precomposition by the pullback projection.

The given morphism is a closed immersion. For a continuous integer-valued function on its closed inverse image in V, choose at each point in the closed image an ambient open whose inverse image is the fibre of that function. Choose the complement of the closed image and value zero at each other point. These opens cover V. Constant functions with these chosen values are local lifts. Hence restriction of continuous functions is locally surjective, including empty V.

The two constant-sheaf comparisons commute with restriction: precompose with the sheafification unit and both sides send an integer to the constant function with that value on the pulled-back chart. The sheafification universal property proves equality. Local surjectivity makes restriction epic, and cancellation of the comparison isomorphism on the target proves that the canonical constant direct-image map is epic.

proof_origin.place: p. 67, supported integer source; explicit ambient-open extension argument, using the source-library realization of Bhatt--Scholze Lemma 4.2.12.
